At least 10 tokens using the same name were launched within minutes of each other. This one (7pvs…) is a Meteora virtual-curve launch trading on PumpSwap. It was created about 5–8 minutes after the two leaders, FT6s (about $255k market cap) and 55Vr (about $84k, the address the GMGN website link points to). It pumped hard and then fell about 55–60% in the last 5 minutes.
